description: Generates people, rooms and objects for a video through Atlas Cloud - the client and key, which model for which job (Seedance 2.0 for shots, OmniHuman 1.5 to play your own audio as a talking person, MiniMax H3 in reserve, Nano Banana Pro for keyframes and multi-reference edits), prices as billed, the doctrine (one scene = one generation; identity, geometry and composition checked at image prices; the reference beats the prompt; approved takes are upscaled, not regenerated), looping and transparent shots, and assembly traps. An executor under video-studio. Use when a film needs shots that do not exist as footage or UI. Triggers: "generate a scene", "a character in the video", "people in the ad", "talking head", "Seedance", "OmniHuman", "Atlas Cloud", "generated video".
